cues.text: A colossal gas giant dominates the void. Sweeping storms of icy cyan light illuminate its right hemisphere.
Luminous rings of frost and dust encircle the deep, shadowed blue of the sphere.
A tiny, brilliant speck of light, the colony ship, glides along the lower rings, drawn toward the frozen world.

beats.note: A large gas giant planet, dark on the left and glowing bright cyan on the right, with sweeping rings.
A tiny bright point of light, the colony ship, is visible moving along the lower left section of the rings.
The ship continues its slow glide along the rings towards the planet.
The scene slowly fades to black.
